propositions: Project-configured code-review criteria merge successfully into the overlay but never execute or produce findings, appearing indistinguishable from a silent failure.
The code-review runtime does not implement the dynamic project-criteria fan-in pattern that plan review uses, leaving no execution path for project-specific LLM-backed code-review criteria.
Project prompt and eval assets must be resolved from the reviewed repository snapshot, with missing or malformed assets raising a fatal LLMError before model execution rather than silently skipping.

The runner must deduplicate activated project prompts against static physical ids and execute each exactly once per review, using a stateless discriminator constant and preserving the versioned workflow schema.

Pass 3 decision logic must apply repository-effective thresholds, blocking posture, and nit-suppression rules using the same routing map, while findings retain their logical criterion ids regardless of physical prompt execution.
